subject: Film & Cinema
title: Storyboards: Blueprints of Vision
description: A quick win: understand Storyboards: Blueprints of Vision.

hook.text: Hitchcock said his films were finished before shooting began. The storyboards told the whole story.

buildup.text: Storyboards are sequential drawings that map every shot, angle, and movement in advance.

discovery.text: They let directors communicate their vision to the entire crew before cameras roll.

twist.text: Some directors — like Mike Leigh — never storyboard, preferring spontaneity and discovery on set.

climax.text: Whether rigid or loose, every great film starts with a plan for what the audience will see.

punchline.text: The sketch becomes the shot becomes the story.

quiz.question: What did Hitchcock mean when he said his films were 'finished' before shooting?
options: His storyboards planned every shot so thoroughly that filming was execution
